name: quotewerks-mcp
description: Typed quote tools for QuoteWerks Web that use the real column names, preview typed writes before sending them, and add margin, win-rate and pipeline answers from a local mirror.

quotewerks_api_key.title: QuoteWerks Web API key
quotewerks_api_key.description: QuoteWerks Web API key sent as the X-API-Key header. Create one in QuoteWerks Web (requires MasterRights); writes need a key with AllowWrite.
